question: Select the correct group of scientists who are the recipients of the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology, 2021.

options.text: Dr. Subimal Ghosh, Dr. Neena Gupta and Dr. Dhiraj Kumar
Dr. Vatsasla Thirumalai, Dr. Abhijit Mukharjee and Dr. Subi Jacob George
Dr. Bushra Ateeq, Dr. Ritesh Agarwal and Dr. Surajit Dhara
Dr. Amit Singh, Dr. Kanishka Biswas and Dr. Anish Ghosh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Amit Singh, Dr. Kanishka Biswas and Dr. Anish Ghosh**__.

• **Dr. Amit Singh, Dr. Kanishka Biswas, and Dr. Anish Ghosh** are the recipients of the **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize **for Science and Technology, **2021**.
